paragraphs.text: Token usage and cost ledger plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Tracks input, output, cached and reasoning
tokens across providers and models, with a monthly heatmap, per session breakdown, and per million t
oken cost estimates.
harness-ledger
English | 中文
A token usage and cost ledger for DeepSeek Harness. It reads usage already recorded in Harness sessi
ons and shows totals, per provider and per model breakdowns, a monthly heatmap, and per session and
per request records in a draggable browser panel. It makes no model calls and keeps its cache in the
dsh user data area.
## Screenshots

Default theme, Chinese interface
Matrix theme, English interface

Per model pricing editor, Paper theme
Compact view and collapsed pill, Midnight theme
## Features

- Account totals for input, output, cache read, cache write, reasoning, and total tokens.
- Usage gr
ouped by provider or model. The model view combines the same model name across providers and shows t

he provider breakdown when expanded.
- A monthly activity calendar. Selecting a day shows sessions w

ith token usage recorded on that day, including older sessions.
- Session totals and recent request

records with time, provider, model, and token counts.
- Per provider or per model price estimates wi

th zero defaults for every discovered provider and model, priced per million tokens.
- Auto, Midnigh

t, Paper, and Matrix panel themes.
- Chinese and English panel text.
The panel refreshes every ten seconds. It displays up to thirty highest-usage sessions and up to twe
lve recent requests for an expanded session.
## Install
The plugin is a normal dsh plugin bundle, so it installs with the standard dsh plugin flow and shows
up in the installed plugins list with its own enable toggle. It never needs an entry in `cordis.pat
he installed plugins list with its own enable toggle. It never needs an entry in `cordis.patch.yml`.
### From the plugin manager
Open the Plugins page, install from the repository address, then restart Harness.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
### From the command line
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Replace `desktop` with your profile name. Restart Harness after the install finishes.
## Pricing
Every provider discovered by Harness starts at zero per million tokens, so the panel works without a
pricing block. Click the `¥` button in the panel header to enter input and output prices. Choose ei
ther **By provider** or **By model**; only the selected mode is used for estimates. Model rates are
keyed by both provider and model, so identical model names from different providers remain distinct.
Both rate tables persist in the browser's local storage. In provider mode, local provider rates tak
e precedence over profile-configured rates.
The provider key must match the ID reported by Harness. Profile configuration remains available when
rates should be shared across browsers or managed centrally:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`inputPerM` and `outputPerM` are prices per million uncached input tokens and output tokens. Zero is
valid and means free.
## Data and cache
The plugin reads session history through Harness services. Its cache contains folded session metadat
a and usage totals, not full message bodies. Cached totals are returned immediately while session hi
story refreshes in the background.
The cache lives in the dsh user data area at `~/.dsh/storages/harness-ledger`, next to the other dsh
storages, so it survives reinstalls and upgrades. Set `DSH_HOME` to use a different dsh root, or se
t `HARNESS_LEDGER_CACHE` before starting Harness to point at a dedicated cache directory. The legacy
`DSH_LEDGER_CACHE` name remains supported.
## Development
The host and browser modules are plain ES modules with no build step.
